verdict.rationale: HubSpot's own docs say users can connect an individual work email inbox to send one-to-one emails from the CRM and log email replies to the CRM, which covers the core of connecting an inbox and logging email. The evidence never names Gmail or Outlook, never describes two-way sync, and never explains how emails are automatically associated with the right records. missing for 10: explicit Gmail/Outlook provider support, documented two-way sync behavior, automatic association of logged emails to the correct contact/deal records, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can connect Gmail or Outlook so emails sync two-way and log automatically to the right records

citations.quote: Connect an individual work email to HubSpot to send one-to-one emails from the CRM, log email replies to the CRM, send sequences emails, and install HubSpot Sales
